simpleweather.title: Simple Weather
simpleweather.option.disableWeather.tool:
Stops rain and thunder from occurring and
clears active weather. Server-side. Default:
false.
simpleweather.option.clientRainParticleD:
Reduces rain particles and sounds. 100 = All
particles/sounds 0 = No particles/sounds
(Silent). Default: 20. Allowed range: 0–100.
simpleweather.option.rainFrequencyFactor:
How often rain starts: the dry spell between two
rains is divided by this factor. 1 = Vanilla,
2 = twice as often, 0.25 = four times as rare.
Rain length stays Vanilla. Default: 1. Range:
0.25–4.
simpleweather.option.thunderFrequencyFac:
How often thunderstorms start, same scale as the
rain factor (own countdown). Default: 1. Range:
0.25–4.
